    What we supply

    The catalogue is organised in three categories. Every entry lists its botanical or chemical identity, marker compound or CAS number, and the forms we supply.

    1. 01

      Botanical Extracts

      Spice and aromatic botanicals (ginger, turmeric, pepper, cinnamon, nutmeg and green tea) supplied as standardized extracts, oleoresins, CO₂ extracts and essential oils for food, beverage, nutraceutical and pharmaceutical formulation.

      Ginger · Turmeric · Pepper · Cinnamon · Nutmeg · Green Tea

      6 products
    2. 02

      Nutraceutical Ingredients

      Standardized botanical actives for supplement and functional-food manufacturers, each extract specified by its marker compound, from withanolides and bacosides to hydroxycitric acid and chlorogenic acid.

      Garcinia Cambogia · Green Coffee · Ashwagandha · Tulsi · Boswellia Serrata · Bacopa

      6 products
    3. 03

      Cosmetic Ingredients

      Aroma chemicals for fragrance, flavor and specialty-chemical manufacturers: aliphatic and symmetric dialkyl ketones, and substituted acetophenones, listed by CAS number.

      Fragrance & flavor ketones · Symmetric dialkyl ketones · Acetophenones

      6-Undecanone927-49-14-Heptanone123-19-3Acetophenone98-86-2
      17 compounds

    Standardized to marker compounds

    Typical grades for our standardized botanicals. The exact grade is agreed per order and confirmed on the Certificate of Analysis.

    ProductBotanical namePart usedMarker compoundTypical grade
    Ginger Zingiber officinale Rhizome (root) Zingiberene, Gingerols, Shogaols 5% / 10% / 20% / 40% available
    Turmeric Curcuma longa Rhizome (root) Curcumin Nutra-grade typically 95% curcuminoids
    Pepper Piper nigrum Fruit (peppercorn) Piperine Oleoresin typically 90–98% piperine
    Garcinia Cambogia Garcinia gummi-gutta Fruit rind Hydroxycitric Acid (HCA) Typical range 50–60% HCA
    Green Coffee Coffea arabica / robusta Unroasted bean Chlorogenic Acid Typical range 45–50% total CGA
    Green Tea Camellia sinensis Leaf EGCG, Catechins, Polyphenols Typical range 40–90% polyphenols, or 45–50% EGCG
    Ashwagandha Withania somnifera Root (root-only extraction) Withanolides Typical range 2.5–5% withanolides
    Boswellia Serrata Boswellia serrata Gum resin Boswellic Acids, AKBA Typical range 65–70% boswellic acids, or AKBA-enriched
    Bacopa Bacopa monnieri Whole herb Bacosides Typical range 20–50% bacosides

    From raw material to documented batch

    Procurement, extraction, filtration, concentration, drying, standardization and packaging are run in-house, from specification to finished product.

    Every batch is traceable from raw material through to the finished product.
    Raw material testing
    Incoming botanical material is tested before it enters production.

    Batch-level checks before anything is cleared to ship.
    Documentation
    Certificate of Analysis per batch; specification sheet, TDS and SDS on request.
    Flow & vapour-phase chemistry
    High-pressure operation up to 50 bar and reactions up to 600 °C, with reactor configurations for scale-up from pilot to commercial scale.

    About Incretuss

    The name comes from the Latin incrementum, growth, and rectus, correct: growth that is precise, not just fast.

    In practice that means a focused product range rather than an unfocused one, in-house manufacturing rather than resold stock, and documentation provided as standard rather than on demand.
